cohort: 19 patients diagnosed with uSTUMP between January 2000 and February 2018 at CHA Bundang Medical Center
finding: The study found a uSTUMP recurrence rate of 10.5% and that fertility-preserving management is possible with careful follow-up.
mod_finding: Three out of five patients who desired pregnancy after uterine-preserving treatment for uSTUMP successfully delivered live births by Cesarean section without complications.
gest_age: Full term (for the 3 patients who delivered)
